newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Off 0.100 to up 0.100 cent. Weaker fed markets seen ahead but technically firm and back months may follow feeders.
FEEDER CATTLE - Up 0.200 to 0.300 cent. Sharp rise in index and weak corn futures indications.
LEAN HOGS - Up 0.150 to off 0.150 cent. Cash hog markets strong on higher cutout but see weaker markets ahead.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Weak cash market and expectations on out-of-town report mostly bearish.
